items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: He played like little bluesy stuff. Something like Professor Longhair.

ctx.x: Yeah, Ape Man. Ape Man, yeah.

He played little things on the piano. But he couldn't play like my dad. He played like little bluesy stuff. Something like Professor Longhair. That's where Ape Man played, something similar to that. I can't think of anybody. Next door on 616 Bell Castle Street, there used to be another guy. He was almost blind. He used to play guitar. I used to hear him strumming the guitar all the time. But I never did know, I didn't know what he was playing because I wasn't very interested at the time, you know. That's about…
Do you have any street parades? I mean, just.
